```{r}
df <- read.csv("data/baseball _records.csv")


```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

df %>% 
  filter(player_name == 'Yoda', hit_type == "HR") %>% 
  select(player_name, hit_type) %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())




  
  
  


  

```

# Total Reocords

```{r}
sort(unique(df$rbi))
sort(unique(df$hit_type))
```

![]()

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)

# Total Hit Records
## Total At Bat
total_at_bat_b <- df %>% 
  filter(event %in% c("HIT",'OUT', 'E', 'K')) %>% 
  count(player_name, name = "AB") %>% 
  arrange(desc(AB))

## Total rbi
total_rbi_b <- df %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(rbi_b = sum(rbi, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(rbi_b))

## Total 1B 
total_one_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == '1B') %>% 
  mutate(one_b_b = hit_type == '1B') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(single = sum(one_b_b)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(single))

## Total 2B 
total_two_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == '2B') %>% 
  mutate(two_b_b = hit_type == '2B') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(double = sum(two_b_b)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(double))

total_two_base_b

## Total 3B 
total_three_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == '3B') %>% 
  mutate(three_b_b = hit_type == '3B') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(triple = sum(three_b_b)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(triple))

total_three_base_b

## Total HR 
total_hr_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == 'HR') %>% 
  mutate(hr_b = hit_type == 'HR') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(hr = sum(hr_b)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(hr))

total_hr_base_b

## Total Batting Average
total_records_both <- df %>% 
  mutate(rem_sac = (event == 'OUT') & !is.na(rbi),
         total_ab = event %in% c("HIT",'OUT', 'E', 'K') & !rem_sac,
         hit = event == 'HIT',
         one_base = hit_type == '1B',
         two_base = hit_type == '2B',
         three_base = hit_type == '3B',
         hr = hit_type == 'HR',
         bb = event == 'BB') %>%
  
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    AB_b = sum(total_ab, na.rm = TRUE),
    HIT_b = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    AV_b = HIT_b/AB_b,
    RBI_b = sum(rbi, na.rm = TRUE),
    One_b = sum(one_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    Double_b = sum(two_base, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Triple_b = sum(three_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hr_b = sum(hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Bb_b = sum(bb, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(HIT_b))


kable(
  total_records_both,
  caption = "Total Records"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  ) %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "azure", background = "#6495ED") %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "darkcyan") %>% 
  footnote(general = "This order based on HIT")


```

```{r}
## Total At Bat
total_at_bat <- df %>% 
  filter(event != 'BB') %>% 
  count(player_name) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))

## Total HIT
total_hit <- df %>% 
  filter(event == 'HIT') %>% 
  count(player_name) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))


batting_ave <- df %>% 
    mutate(
        total = event != "BB",
        hit = event == "HIT"
    ) %>% 
    group_by(player_name) %>% 
    summarise(
      AB = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      H = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
      AV = H/AB)  %>% 
  arrange(desc(AB))



batting_ave
```

```{r}
#install.packages("kableExtra")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Total hits for BOTH
hits_both <- df %>%
  filter(event == "HIT") %>%
  count(player_name, name = "total hit")

# Total hits for SOFTBALL
hits_softball <- df %>%
  filter(event == "HIT", sport == "s") %>%
  count(player_name, name = "total_hit_softball")

# Total hits for BASEBALL
hits_baseball <- df %>%
  filter(event == "HIT", sport == "b") %>%
  count(player_name, name = "total_hit_baseball")

# Combine into one table (include players with 0 too)
hits_table <- df %>%
  distinct(player_name) %>%
  left_join(hits_both, by = "player_name") %>%
  left_join(hits_softball, by = "player_name") %>%
  left_join(hits_baseball, by = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(
    `total hit` = replace_na(`total hit`, 0),
    total_hit_softball = replace_na(total_hit_softball, 0),
    total_hit_baseball = replace_na(total_hit_baseball, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`total hit`))

hits_table


```

```{r}

kable(
  hits_table,
  caption = "Total Hits (Both / Softball / Baseball)"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  ) %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "azure", background = "#6495ED") %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "darkcyan") %>% 
  footnote(general = "THis is a general footnote")
```
